text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
we stopped by a shopping mall, where—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nyowaaa~!
Th-Th-This is a huge crisis!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Fukukitaru?
Holding your head in your hands like that...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness?! What incredible luck!
A savior in my hour of need—Suzuka-san to the rescue!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In any case! Please take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Does this mean—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Exaaactly right! You enter your names,and this nifty machine does a compatibility reading for just one coin!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
By Lady Shiraoki's divine guidance,
I must behold a 100% compatibility result in this game—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How foolish of me!
I completely forgot the person I was supposed to do the divination with!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: T-That sounds... terrible...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So Suzuka-san, please lend a hand~!
They say this fortune telling is super accurate!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"That's fine and all, but...
Do I just do fortune-telling with Fukukitaru?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that doesn't matter. It just said 'seeing 100% compatibility
brings good fortune,' so I only need to stand next to you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Although, if you're personally requesting me,
I'll gladly take on the job!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Lady Shiraoki is pretty vague, huh...
Anyway, then with who—
choice_data_list: Why don't you try it with Matikanefukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Lady Shiraoki is pretty vague, huh...
Anyway, then with who—
choice_data_list: Why don't you try it with Matikanefukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: With Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Then allow me to watch from the sidelines as you two super-compatible folks get your fortune told!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"W-Will it really be alright?
It has to be 100%, right...?"
(Clink!)

text_block_list.name: Game
text_block_list.text: "Please enter both of your names!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, "Silence Suzuka" and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Just hearing the name sounds like a match made in heaven...! This must be destiny!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... the bar's been getting raised pretty high,
so don't be disappointed if it's not 100%, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's an unlucky year or the worst cosmic cycle,
there's no way that's happening!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You two make the absolute best partners!
Right, Suzuka-san's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Geez, not you too, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Well then, here I go—

text_block_list.name: Game
text_block_list.text: "The compatibility between the two of you is—"

text_block_list.name: Game
text_block_list.text:
"—100%! Truly soulmates!
Expressing daily gratitude to each other will bring good fortune!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes! My eyes do not deceive me!
Phew, praise be, praise be...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-It really came out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, here are the fortune-telling results.
Both of you, please express your gratitude to each other!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh?
Dropping that on me so suddenly is...
choice_data_list: Thank you for always running with such high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, please wait a moment.
Let's see, um—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: For always training me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nfufufu~! Looking good, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on...
Stop teasing me...!

"Through the compatibility fortune-telling,
it seemed the bond of trust with Silence Suzuka grew even deeper."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
If it's for fortune-telling, this Matikanefukukitaru will head out at full power!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is write your name,
so giving it your all seems a bit much...
(Clink!)

text_block_list.name: Game
text_block_list.text: "Please enter both of your names!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, "Silence Suzuka" and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Machikane Fukukitaru"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nfufu, I can see it...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san and my perfect compatibility is...
just like a pair of guardian komainu standing before a torii gate...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "T-There really isn't much to get worked up about, though..."

text_block_list.name: Game
text_block_list.text: "The compatibility between the two of you is—"

text_block_list.name: Game
text_block_list.text:
"—95%! So close, just one step away!
It might be good to compete together once in a while!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaaaaaa~~h!!
It's not... 100%...!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, but...
They say it's good to compete against each other.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words, that's the key to bridging the remaining 5%!
Understood! Suzuka-san, let's immediately—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Then let's race from here back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...H-Hold on a second~!

A few days later, when the two of them tried the compatibility fortune-telling again,
they apparently scored a perfect 100%.
